disposition_mapping.rationale: Document assembly is pure retrieval/reconciliation logic with no judgment content; it is folded into the deterministic match pipeline. Per council consensus (finance_domain, emerging_economy, agentic_architect), assembly failures are not silently retried but surfaced as a distinct, typed 'linkage pending/failed' state, separate from variance exceptions, so routing to the correct owner (buyer/receiving vs. AP analyst) is preserved rather than lost in consolidation.

Quantity matching is deterministic rule evaluation with no genuine judgment content in the baseline's human role; it is implemented as a versioned, auditable rules function inside the execution pipeline, computed against cumulative received quantity across multiple GRNs per PO line to avoid manufacturing false exceptions on ordinary partial-receipt patterns. Satisfies TWM-R-01 (function preserved) and TWM-R-03 (GRN data still consumed).

Price and terms matching is likewise deterministic and is merged into the same pipeline, emitting typed variance output (price/freight/tax/terms/PO-data-quality) so downstream routing is not degraded, and capturing FX spot-rate initial recognition for cross-currency invoices as a discrete sub-contract of this function rather than leaving it to be assumed elsewhere. Satisfies TWM-R-02 (function preserved) and TWM-R-04 (PO data still consumed).

Tolerance evaluation becomes the terminal stage of the same deterministic pipeline, but the tolerance policy itself is held in a service architecturally independent of the matching logic's deploy cycle, versioned and owned by a named human, because a tolerance band is in substance an accounting-policy choice (IAS 8 consistency) and must be verifiable, not archaeologically reconstructed. Satisfies TWM-R-05 (function preserved) and TWM-R-06 (tolerance policy still consumed, now in auditable form).

Exception resolution survives as a single workflow function but is internally reorganised into three bounded tiers (mechanical auto-resolve / evidence-attached propose-confirm / human-investigated long tail), closing the baseline's unacknowledged need for vendor-correspondence and contract-term inputs, prohibiting silent-timeout auto-confirmation, and requiring an evidenced basis for every resolution so that disposing of a candidate error is correction, not suppression (IAS 8 error-correction principle). Satisfies TWM-R-10, and precedes release approval per TWM-R-08.

Release approval survives but is reshaped to concentrate supervisor judgment on exception-resolved and override cases, carrying full resolution evidence forward (not just a classification flag) to avoid a rubber-stamp approval, adding a risk-weighted sample over auto-released matches and a documented degraded-mode path. Satisfies TWM-R-07; ordering after resolution satisfies TWM-R-08; the approving actor is system-enforced distinct from the resolution actor, satisfying TWM-R-09, with a named compensating control for thin-staffing rather than leaving the separation requirement unrunnable in small teams.

Council rejected elimination by strong majority (six of seven positions): automatic, native capture of match-outcome data answers only the retention half of the evidentiary-trail requirement (KB-02); a demonstrated capacity to reconcile reported balances to their basis requires a positioned, accountable reviewer with real authority to act on drift, not a passive dashboard. Retained as a restructured function pairing an autonomous statistical monitoring process (flag-and-recommend only) with a named human reviewer who holds actual pause/rollback authority, logged as a documented, attributable event, and made available in low-bandwidth exportable form for constrained-connectivity sites.

steps.actor: Automated matching engine (deterministic rules, configuration and tolerance policy owned by AP policy owner/controller)
steps.description: A deterministic, versioned rules pipeline — not a probabilistic or learned-model component — assembles the invoice/PO/GRN document set, computes quantity variance against cumulative (not single-GRN) received quantity, computes price/freight/tax/terms variance against the purchase order with typed output categories (price, freight, tax, terms, PO-data-quality), captures spot-rate initial recognition for cross-currency invoices as part of this computation, and classifies each result as clean, within-tolerance, or exception against a tolerance policy held in a service architecturally independent of the matching logic, versioned and owned by a named AP policy owner/controller. Document sets that cannot be formed are not silently retried into the generic exception population; they are emitted as a distinct, timestamped 'linkage pending/failed' state (receiving-side or data-quality cause identified where determinable) that ages visibly and escalates past a configurable SLA. Every computation writes an immutable, replayable event recording the inputs, the policy version consumed, and the output, so that what was compared, under what tolerance, and when, is reconstructible after the fact. The pipeline is specifiable as event-driven or batch-polled without changing its logic or log contract, so it remains deployable on constrained, intermittently-connected infrastructure.
steps.name: Automated Match Execution (Deterministic Rules Engine)
outputs: Assembled match document set / linkage status (pending, failed, complete)
Price and terms variance detail (typed: price, freight, tax, terms, PO-data-quality)
FX initial recognition record (spot rate, functional-currency value) for cross-currency invoices

steps.actor: AP analyst (tiered: mechanical rule auto-resolves without human touch; agent-proposed/human-confirmed mid-tier; human-investigated long tail), distinct from the release-approval actor
steps.description: Exceptions and linkage failures are routed by type to one of three bounded tiers. Tier (a): narrowly-defined, genuinely mechanical exceptions (rounding within a published epsilon, UOM conversion against a published table) auto-resolve with a logged basis and no human sign-off; this tier's scope is deliberately kept narrow, with the burden of proof on treating a category as non-judgmental, to avoid silently suppressing candidate errors. Tier (b): recurring vendor-pattern exceptions are drafted with a full evidence and citation trail (prior resolutions, correspondence, policy clauses, confidence signal) by a retrieval-and-proposal function, and become final only on an explicit, attributable human confirmation — no transition from proposed to resolved occurs on a silent SLA timeout. Tier (c): judgment-heavy, long-tail exceptions (disputed short-shipments, contract-amendment timing, quality rejections netted against invoice) are investigated by the analyst substantially from primary sources — vendor correspondence and contract terms, which are explicit inputs this function requires — with automation limited to surfacing relevant material, not proposing resolutions. Every resolution, at every tier, is evidenced: what was found, why it was accepted, corrected, or rejected, and corrections flow forward into the recorded cost basis. Auto-resolution authority for tier boundaries is extended only against this organisation's locally-observed exception population and a documented false-positive track record, with a named owner accountable for any tier-boundary change.
inputs: Exception-classified match (with variance type and linkage status)
steps.name: Exception Investigation and Resolution (Tiered, Evidence-Attached)
outputs: Exception resolution evidence (tier, evidence trail, basis for treating variance as error or not)

steps.actor: AP supervisor (system-enforced separation from the exception-resolution actor, with a documented compensating control for thin-staffing deployments)
steps.description: Clean and tolerance-passed matches route to automatic release as a direct function of classification; a risk-weighted sample (new vendors, recent master-data change, near-tolerance-boundary cases) is drawn at the moment of auto-release into a reviewable queue, not a flat random sample. Exception-resolved and override cases route to a supervisor who is shown the full resolution evidence and rationale, not merely the binary classification, so approval reflects genuine engagement rather than a rubber stamp. The gate establishes the determinable recognition timestamp and amount at which the matched/resolved invoice is confirmed as a payable. A documented degraded-mode manual-release path exists for engine or connectivity outages, using locally-cached data, with every manually-released item flagged for retrospective reconciliation and review. The approving actor is system-enforced to differ from the actor who confirmed the preceding exception resolution; where staffing is too thin to support this at all times, a documented, logged, time-boxed compensating control (pooled/rotating reviewer, or same-person action under mandatory heightened retrospective review) is the named fallback rather than an unspecified gap.
steps.name: Match Release Gate (Exception-Focused, Evidence-Attached)
outputs: Released match authorisation (with determinable recognition timestamp and basis)

steps.actor: AP accountant / controller delegate (named, accountable reviewer with intervention authority), supported by an autonomous monitoring function
steps.description: A continuously or periodically running monitoring process computes vendor-level and category-level trend statistics (match rate, override rate, exception-tier mix, linkage-failure aging) against historical baselines and pushes prioritised, evidenced alerts to a named, accountable reviewer, rather than relying on someone remembering to open a dashboard. The reviewer's authority is real: they may pause or roll back an auto-resolution or auto-release tier pending investigation, but any such pause is logged as a discrete, documented, attributable event with stated reasoning — treated as a policy-affecting action requiring the same surfaced-change discipline as a tolerance-band edit, not an informal emergency override. The monitoring agent's own authority stops at flagging and recommending; it cannot itself commit a pause. Output is produced both as live, pushed alerts and as a periodically-generated, exportable, low-bandwidth artifact, so the function remains usable at sites without reliable continuous connectivity or licensed BI tooling.
steps.name: Match Control Reporting (Monitoring Agent + Accountable Reviewer)
outputs: Match-rate and override report (live and exportable)
Tier pause/rollback authorisation record (where issued, with documented basis)
